typography.heading_treatment: Elegant, high-contrast serif headings set in Playfair Display with generous size scaling, tight letter-spacing on display sizes, and sentence case to reinforce a distinguished, storied tone. H1s lead with gravitas; H2–H3 maintain classical hierarchy with clear weight differentiation.
typography.body_treatment: Source Serif 4 used for all body copy, article text, and longer descriptive passages. Set at comfortable reading sizes with a generous line height (approx. 1.7) and moderate line length to honour the editorial, authoritative voice of the brand. typography.accent_treatment: Montserrat in small caps or uppercase with wide letter-spacing used for eyebrow labels, stat figures, membership tier names, navigation items, badge text, and metadata. Provides formal sans-serif contrast against the serif type system, reinforcing the heritage-classic aesthetic across card grids and section headers.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Home page for Courtside & Crown is the definitive first impression of a century-old tennis institution. Every design decision must reinforce the heritage_classic aesthetic — formal, prestigious, warm, and storied — while maintaining the clarity and navigability expected of a modern card-grid layout family.

**Overall Page Rhythm & Section Sequencing:**
The page flows through five distinct sections with deliberate tonal shifts: (1) a commanding full-viewport hero that anchors prestige, (2) a tight horizontal stats band that delivers authority through numbers, (3) a three-column feature card grid that communicates the academy's core pillars, (4) a testimonial card row that introduces human warmth and social proof, and (5) a richly textured full-width CTA close. This arc moves from grandiose establishment → credibility → clarity of offering → emotional resonance → conversion. Each section transition uses a subtle ornamental rule or a tonal background shift to create breathing room without breaking the formal register.

**Background & Color Rhythm:**
Sections alternate between Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) and Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) backgrounds to create gentle layered depth without sharp contrast breaks. The hero and CTA sections use Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) as the dominant dark surface, bookending the page with gravitas. Championship Gold (#B8962E) is used sparingly as a decorative accent — ornamental dividers, rule lines, badge borders — never as a background fill. Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F) drives all primary CTAs, active states, and key highlight moments. Forest Court (#2D5016) appears only in category tags and incidental squad indicators. Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) handles all card borders and divider lines.

**Typography Hierarchy:**
All headings are set in Playfair Display — H1 at a commanding display scale (clamp between 52px–80px), H2 at 36–48px, H3 at 24–30px — with tight letter-spacing at large sizes and sentence case throughout. Eyebrow labels use Montserrat in uppercase small caps with wide letter-spacing (0.15–0.2em), set in Championship Gold or Burgundy Crest depending on background darkness. Body and descriptive copy uses Source Serif 4 at 17–18px with 1.7 line height. Stat figures and metadata use Montserrat uppercase, bold, at oversized display scale. Card metadata and captions use Montserrat at 11–12px, Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A).

**Layout Grid & Density:**
The page uses a 12-column grid with a max content width of 1280px, centered with generous horizontal padding (80px desktop, 40px tablet, 20px mobile). Sections maintain vertical padding of 96px top/bottom on desktop, scaling to 64px on tablet and 48px on mobile. The card grid sections use a 3-column layout on desktop, 2-column on tablet, and 1-column on mobile, with 28px gutters. Cards have 32px internal padding, rounded corners at 4px (restrained, not modern-bubbly), and a 1px Slate Mist border with a subtle box shadow (0 2px 12px rgba(27,42,74,0.08)) for elevation.

**Visual Motifs & Ornamental Language:**
Symmetrical composition is enforced wherever possible — centered section headers, balanced two-CTA arrangements, evenly spaced card grids. Ornamental dividers (thin horizontal rules flanked by small diamond or lozenge marks in Championship Gold) separate eyebrow labels from headlines in major sections. Crest-like marks and the central emblem illustration in the hero reinforce the heraldic vocabulary. No rounded pill buttons — CTAs use rectangular buttons with 2px solid borders, either filled (Burgundy Crest background, Crown Ivory text) or outlined (Crown Ivory border, Crown Ivory text on dark backgrounds).

**Responsive Behavior:**
On mobile, the hero stacks vertically with the emblem illustration centered above the headline. Stat items stack to a 2×2 grid then single column. Feature cards and testimonial cards become single-column scrollable stacks. The CTA section maintains its textured background but reduces padding; both CTA buttons stack vertically and expand to full width. Navigation collapses to a hamburger menu that slides in from the right with a Courtside Navy overlay.

**Fit Within the Shared Design System:**
This page establishes the visual language that all subsequent pages inherit. The hero's emblem, the gold ornamental dividers, the Playfair Display headline scale, and the Burgundy Crest CTA button style must be treated as the canonical reference for the entire site. The page demonstrates the full color palette in use, introduces all three typefaces in their correct roles, and validates the card-grid layout family as the primary structural pattern.

At the very top center, place the hero emblem illustration — a vintage crest-style rendering of a tennis racket crossed with a laurel wreath in fine line detail. Directly below the emblem, place the eyebrow label 'Est. 1923 · A Century of Champions' in Montserrat uppercase, wide letter-spacing (0.2em), 12px, Championship Gold (#B8962E). At the top center, place the eyebrow label 'Your First Step Starts Here' in Montserrat uppercase, 11px, wide letter-spacing (0.18em), Championship Gold (#B8962E). Below it, the headline 'Ready to Step onto the Court?' in Playfair Display, 52px on desktop (36px on mobile), Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8), sentence case, centered, max-width 700px. Separate the text block from the CTAs with a centered ornamental divider: a 60px Championship Gold horizontal rule with flanking diamond lozenges, 28px vertical margin above and below.

Below the divider, place two CTA buttons side by side with 16px gap, centered. Hover state: border shifts to Championship Gold, background deepens slightly. pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Club page serves as the definitive authoritative overview of Courtside & Crown — a richly layered, heritage-driven editorial experience that earns the trust of prospective members through storytelling, credibility, and clarity. The page must feel like a distinguished club brochure brought to life digitally, blending gravitas with warmth.

**Overall Page Rhythm & Section Flow:**
The page opens with a grand, symmetrical page header that anchors the heritage identity. It then descends into a vertical timeline section that narrates the club's century of history. The coaching team is presented in a card grid at mid-page, followed by a clearly differentiated pricing/membership tier grid. The page closes with a facilities feature grid before handing off to the global footer. This rhythm moves from emotional storytelling → historical proof → human credibility → commercial conversion → physical reassurance — a deliberate funnel that respects the audience's decision-making journey.

**Color Usage Across the Page:**
- Primary background: Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) for the majority of the page body, lending the parchment warmth appropriate to a heritage institution.
- The page header section uses a deep Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) full-bleed background to command authority at entry.
- The timeline section alternates on Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) to provide visual separation and a warm archival feel.
- The coaching grid returns to Crown Ivory, keeping the mid-page light and approachable.
- The membership/pricing section uses Courtside Navy as a full-bleed dark background, creating a strong visual break and lending gravitas to the commercial proposition.
- The facilities grid returns to Antique Linen, closing the page on a warm, reassuring note.
- Championship Gold (#B8962E) is used consistently for ornamental rule lines, crest marks, badge accents, and decorative dividers throughout.
- Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F) is reserved for primary CTAs, active highlights, and ornamental flourishes at section transitions.
- Forest Court (#2D5016) appears as tag/badge color on coaching credentials and facility category indicators.
- Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) for all card borders, dividers, and input outlines.
- Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A) for all secondary body copy, captions, and metadata labels.

**Typography Hierarchy:**
- All section eyebrows use Montserrat in small caps, uppercase, wide letter-spacing (0.15em+), set in Championship Gold — consistent across every section as a formal label system.
- Section headlines use Playfair Display, set large and with tight tracking, in either Crown Ivory (on dark backgrounds) or Courtside Navy (on light backgrounds).
- Subheadlines use Source Serif 4 in a medium italic weight at a comfortable reading size.
- Body copy uses Source Serif 4 at 17–18px with line-height ~1.75, set in Ink Smoke on light backgrounds or Antique Linen/Slate Mist on dark.
- Card titles use Playfair Display at H4 scale; card metadata/labels use Montserrat small caps.
- CTA buttons use Montserrat uppercase with wide spacing, solid fills.

**Card Grid System:**
Cards throughout the page share a consistent visual language: rounded corners (4–6px radius, restrained to avoid modern softness), a subtle 1px Slate Mist border, and on-hover a lift to Antique Linen background with a Championship Gold left-border accent. Cards on dark backgrounds invert to navy-on-ivory with gold accents. Cards maintain generous internal padding (24–32px) and clear typographic hierarchy within.

**Symmetry & Ornamental Details:**
Every section header is horizontally centered with an ornamental Championship Gold rule line (thin, ~1px, 60px wide) placed between the eyebrow and the headline — a consistent decorative motif across all sections. Crest-like decorative marks (small symmetrical flourishes or laurel-adjacent SVG ornaments) appear at section transitions and at the top of the page header. The overall page composition is symmetrical: centered section headers, balanced card grids (2- or 4-column), and centered CTAs.

**Layout Density & Spacing:**
This is a "hard" difficulty page with rich content. Sections use generous vertical padding (80–100px top/bottom on desktop) to avoid crowding. Card grids breathe with 24–32px gutters. The timeline uses a center-spine layout on desktop. Responsive behavior: on tablet (≤1024px), card grids collapse from 4-col to 2-col; on mobile (≤640px), all grids go to single column, the timeline spine collapses to a left-aligned list, and section padding reduces to 48–56px. Navigation and footer are inherited from the shared design system (Courtside Navy bar with Montserrat nav items and Championship Gold active underlines).

**Page Fit Within Site:**
As the second page after Home, The Club page must validate the brand promise established on the landing page. It goes deeper and wider — more text, more structured information — but never loses the premium, heritage character. It should feel like the inside of a distinguished club: ordered, warm, and quietly impressive.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
**Section Type:** Page Header
**Background:** Full-bleed Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) background, occupying 100% viewport width and a minimum height of 480px on desktop (560px on large screens). The background carries a very subtle radial vignette darkening toward the edges to give depth without distraction.

**Ornamental Asset — Vintage Timeline Banner (Illustration):**
Position the vintage-style timeline banner illustration as a decorative horizontal strip spanning the lower third of the section, sitting below the text block. It should be rendered at approximately 80% of the container width, centered horizontally, with a slight opacity overlay (85%) so it reads as a textural background element rather than a competing focal point. The illustration depicts key club milestones from 1923 to present with small iconographic decade markers in a sepia/gold palette, consistent with the parchment-and-gold heritage aesthetic. It bleeds softly into the navy background via a vertical fade gradient at its top edge.

**Layout & Composition:**
All text content is vertically and horizontally centered within the section, stacked in a single column, max-width 760px, centered on the page. The composition is strictly symmetrical.

**Eyebrow:** 'Our Story' — rendered in Montserrat, uppercase, small caps, wide letter-spacing (0.18em), 11–12px, in Championship Gold (#B8962E). Positioned at the top of the text stack.

**Ornamental Divider:** Immediately below the eyebrow, a thin 1px horizontal rule in Championship Gold, 56px wide, centered — the consistent ornamental motif for all section headers across this page.

**Headline:** 'A Club Built on Courts and Character' — Playfair Display, display weight, approximately 52–58px on desktop (36px on mobile), sentence case, tight letter-spacing (-0.01em), set in Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8). Two lines maximum, centered.

**Subheadline:** 'Since 1923, Courtside & Crown has shaped players and people in equal measure.' — Source Serif 4, italic, 20px, line-height 1.6, in Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) at 85% opacity. Centered, max-width 600px.

**Body Copy:** The paragraph beginning 'What began as a small grass-court club…' — Source Serif 4, regular, 17px, line-height 1.75, in Slate Mist (#D6D9E0), centered, max-width 680px. Two lines of generous text that read like an opening statement in a club programme.

**Decorative Crest Mark:** A small symmetrical crest-like ornamental flourish (laurel-adjacent, non-photographic) in Championship Gold sits centered above the eyebrow label, approximately 36px tall, acting as a visual anchor and brand marker.

**No CTAs** in this section — the header is purely atmospheric and narrative.

**Spacing:** 80px top padding, 40px between text block bottom and the timeline illustration strip, 0px bottom padding (the illustration bleeds into the section bottom edge). On mobile, reduce top padding to 48px, headline to 34px, and the illustration is hidden or reduced to a subtle texture strip.

**Section Type:** Timeline
**Background:** Full-bleed Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) to create visual separation from the navy page header above. Section padding: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 56px on mobile.

**Section Header (Centered):**
Eyebrow: 'Our History' — Montserrat, uppercase, small caps, Championship Gold (#B8962E), 11px, wide letter-spacing (0.18em), centered.
Ornamental Gold Rule: 1px horizontal line, 56px wide, Championship Gold, centered, between eyebrow and headline.
Headline: 'One Hundred Years, One Unbroken Tradition' — Playfair Display, ~44px desktop / 30px mobile, Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A), centered, sentence case, max-width 640px.

**Timeline Layout — Desktop (≥1024px):**
A vertical center-spine layout. A continuous 2px vertical line runs down the center of the section in Championship Gold (#B8962E). Each entry connects to the spine via a short 24px horizontal rule in Championship Gold. **Timeline Entry Cards:**
Each entry is presented as a compact card: Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) background, 1px Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, 4px border-radius, 24px internal padding. Maximum card width 340px.
- Year/Title: Playfair Display, H4 scale (~20px), Courtside Navy, bold weight. The year portion is set in Championship Gold to visually anchor the date.
- Description: Source Serif 4, 15px, line-height 1.7, Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A).
Cards have a subtle drop shadow (0 2px 8px rgba(27,42,74,0.08)) for gentle lift off the linen background.

**Timeline Layout — Mobile (≤640px):**
The alternating layout collapses to a single left-aligned list. The vertical spine moves to the far left (16px from the container edge). All cards are full-width, left-aligned, connected to the spine by a short horizontal rule. Node medallions remain. Vertical spacing between entries: 32px.

**Spacing Between Entries (Desktop):** 48px vertical gap between consecutive entry pairs.

**Bottom of Section:** A thin ornamental Championship Gold rule (full container width, 1px) with a small centered crest flourish marks the section close before transitioning to the coaching grid.

**Section Type:** Item Grid (Coaching Team)
**Background:** Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) — returning to the primary page background for warmth and approachability. Section padding: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 56px on mobile.

**Section Header (Centered):**
Eyebrow: 'Our Coaches' — Montserrat, uppercase, small caps, Championship Gold (#B8962E), 11px, 0.18em letter-spacing, centered.
Ornamental Gold Rule: 1px line, 56px wide, Championship Gold, centered.
Headline: 'Guided by the Best in the Game' — Playfair Display, ~44px desktop / 30px mobile, Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A), centered.
Subheadline: 'Every coach at Courtside & Crown holds LTA Level 3 or above certification and brings a passion for player development.' — Source Serif 4, italic, 18px, Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A), centered, max-width 600px, line-height 1.65.

**Card Grid Layout:**
Four coach cards arranged in a 4-column grid on desktop (≥1024px), 2-column on tablet (768px–1023px), 1-column on mobile. Column gap: 24px. Row gap: 24px. Container max-width: 1120px, horizontally centered.

**Coach Card Anatomy:**
Each card: Crown Ivory background, 1px Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, 6px border-radius, 28px internal padding. On hover: background shifts to Antique Linen (#EAE3D2), left border becomes 3px solid Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F), subtle shadow deepens.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Fixtures page for Courtside & Crown operates as a structured, information-dense listing page that balances competitive energy with the heritage-classic aesthetic of the brand. The page uses a Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) primary background with Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) alternating section panels to create depth and rhythm without visual monotony. All section transitions are marked by fine Championship Gold (#B8962E) ornamental rule lines — a single 1px horizontal rule flanked by small diamond or laurel motifs — reinforcing the formal, editorial character of the design system.

The overall layout family is Card Grid: fixture and result entries are rendered as modular cards arranged in a responsive grid (2-column on desktop, 1-column on mobile), with consistent padding, border treatments, and typographic hierarchy across all cards. Cards use Crown Ivory surfaces with a 1px Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, a subtle box shadow on hover shifting to Antique Linen, and Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F) left-border accents on active or featured items.

Visual hierarchy follows a strict three-level system: Playfair Display for all section headlines (H2 level, 32–40px, Courtside Navy), Montserrat in small caps with wide letter-spacing for eyebrow labels and metadata tags (12–13px, Championship Gold or Ink Smoke), and Source Serif 4 for all body descriptions and supporting copy (16–17px, Ink Smoke, line-height ~1.7). Squad category tags and venue/type badges are rendered as small pill-shaped labels in Montserrat uppercase, colour-coded: Forest Court (#2D5016) for Home fixtures, Burgundy Crest for Away, Championship Gold for Tournaments.

Section rhythm across the page: Page Header (full-width, dark navy panel) → Stats Bar (ivory background, 4-column stat grid) → Upcoming Fixtures card grid (antique linen panel) → Recent Results card grid (ivory panel) → CTA Banner (dark navy, full-width). This alternating dark/light/light/light/dark cadence gives the page a composed, editorial structure that mirrors a printed match programme.

Responsive behavior: on desktop (≥1200px), fixture and result cards display in a 2-column grid with generous gutters (32px). On tablet (768–1199px), cards collapse to a single column with tighter padding. On mobile (<768px), all cards are full-width stacked, stat figures remain prominent, and the filter/tag row wraps naturally. Navigation and footer are inherited from the shared design system (Courtside Navy bar, serif brand mark, gold rule accents).

This page fits the cross-site rhythm as the third page — following the Home landing and The Club overview — by shifting from aspirational and narrative tone to functional and informational. It should feel like opening a leather-bound club fixture booklet: structured, trustworthy, and rich with competitive heritage.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The News page for Courtside & Crown functions as an editorial club magazine — "The Courtside Chronicle" — and must feel like a curated, authoritative publication rooted in heritage aesthetics. The overall page background is Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8), providing a warm parchment-like canvas throughout. Alternate sections use Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) to create rhythmic depth and visual breathing room between editorial zones, preventing monotony across a content-dense page.

Section rhythm follows a deliberate editorial cadence: a grand masthead-style page header → a prominent article listing grid → a full-width featured story editorial block → a symmetrical category browse grid → a contained CTA closer. This five-beat rhythm mirrors the pacing of a quality print magazine, moving from announcement to depth to navigation to action.

Typography is strictly hierarchical: all section headlines use Playfair Display in large, high-contrast weights with tight letter-spacing at display sizes, evoking a broadsheet editorial authority. Eyebrow labels throughout use Montserrat in uppercase small caps with wide letter-spacing (0.15–0.2em) in Championship Gold (#B8962E) or Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F), functioning as section identifiers. Body copy and article descriptions use Source Serif 4 at comfortable reading sizes with approximately 1.7 line height.

The card grid layout family is expressed through the article listing section (vertical editorial cards with metadata) and the category browse section (a 3×2 tile grid). Cards use Crown Ivory surfaces with Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) borders, a subtle drop shadow, and Antique Linen hover states. Category tags and date metadata use Montserrat small caps in Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A).

Ornamental dividers — thin horizontal rules in Championship Gold — separate eyebrow labels from headlines in every section, reinforcing the heritage-classic visual language. Symmetrical compositions are used wherever possible: the page header is centred, the featured story block is centred, and the CTA footer is centred.

Colour accents are restrained and purposeful: Burgundy Crest is reserved for primary CTAs, active category highlights, and ornamental flourishes. Championship Gold appears on decorative rule lines, badge-style article count indicators, and crest marks. Forest Court (#2D5016) is used sparingly for category tags such as "Player Achievement" and "Junior Academy" to signal positive, growth-oriented content.

Responsive behaviour: on desktop, the article list renders as a 2-column editorial card grid (with a featured lead card spanning full width at top); on tablet it collapses to a single column with full-width cards; on mobile all sections stack vertically with increased vertical padding. The category grid is 3×2 on desktop, 2×3 on tablet, and 1×6 on mobile. Navigation and footer are inherited from the shared design system in Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A).

The page must feel like a distinguished club publication — not a generic blog. Every typographic and spatial decision should reinforce the sense that this content has been curated with care, pride, and institutional authority.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Contact page for Courtside & Crown should feel like a gracious, unhurried welcome into the clubhouse — warm, accessible, and impeccably organised. It is the final page in the site's five-page rhythm, so it must close the visitor journey with confidence and warmth rather than bureaucratic utility. The overall tone is distinguished hospitality: the visitor should feel that reaching out is a pleasure, not a chore.

Page background is Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) throughout, with Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) used as an alternating panel fill on even-numbered sections to create a gentle layered depth without jarring contrast. The Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) anchors the navigation bar and footer. Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F) is used sparingly but deliberately for primary CTAs, active link states, ornamental dividers, and eyebrow label accents. Championship Gold (#B8962E) appears on decorative rule lines, crest-like badge elements, and section ornaments. Forest Court (#2D5016) is reserved only for inline success or confirmation states if any form interaction is present. Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) defines all borders, input field outlines, and card edges.

Typography follows the shared system strictly: Playfair Display for all H1–H3 headlines in sentence case with tight letter-spacing at display sizes; Source Serif 4 for all body copy and descriptive text at comfortable reading size with line-height ~1.7; Montserrat in small caps or uppercase with wide letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels, metadata, badge text, and contact detail labels.

The layout family is Card Grid. On this contact page, the card grid pattern manifests as: a structured two-column contact info block with an illustrated map asset, a four-card feature grid for enquiry routing, and an accordion-style FAQ panel. Cards throughout use white or Antique Linen surfaces with Slate Mist borders and subtle drop shadows. Card hover states shift the surface to Antique Linen and the border to Championship Gold to signal interactivity with a heritage flourish.

Section rhythm alternates between full-bleed panels and contained-width content columns (max ~1100px centred). Ornamental gold rule dividers (thin horizontal lines with a small central diamond or crest motif in Championship Gold) separate major sections, reinforcing the heritage aesthetic. All sections use generous vertical padding (approximately 80–100px top and bottom on desktop) to maintain an unhurried, formal cadence.

Responsive behaviour: on mobile, all multi-column grids collapse to single-column stacks. The contact info block stacks vertically with the illustrated map below the contact details list. The four-card enquiry grid becomes a two-column grid at tablet and single-column at mobile. The FAQ accordion is single-column at all breakpoints. CTAs are full-width on mobile. Typography scales down gracefully — H1 from ~56px desktop to ~36px mobile, body text remains at 17–18px with generous line height throughout.

This page fits the shared design system by continuing the same navigation bar (Courtside Navy background, Montserrat small-caps links, Championship Gold active underline) and footer (Courtside Navy, ivory type, gold ornamental rule at top) established across all five pages. The page should feel like a natural, reassuring conclusion to the visitor's journey through the site.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
Page Header section for the Contact page. Full-bleed panel with a Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) background, creating a strong, welcoming entry that echoes the site's navigation bar and grounds the page with authority. The panel is symmetrically composed and centred, with all text elements aligned to the horizontal centre axis.

At the very top, the eyebrow label 'We Are Always on Court' is set in Montserrat uppercase with wide letter-spacing (~0.15em), rendered in Championship Gold (#B8962E) at approximately 12–13px. Below the eyebrow, a delicate ornamental divider — a single thin Championship Gold horizontal rule (~60px wide) with a tiny central diamond motif — separates the eyebrow from the headline.

The H1 headline 'Come and Have a Word with Us' is set in Playfair Display, sentence case, ivory (#F5F0E8), at approximately 52–56px on desktop with tight letter-spacing (-0.01em). It should feel warm and inviting rather than imperious — the word 'Word' carries a conversational lightness that the typographic treatment should honour with slightly looser tracking than a typical display headline.

Below the headline, the subheadline 'Whether you are ready to join, curious about coaching, or planning an event — the door to Courtside & Crown is always open.' is set in Source Serif 4, italic style, Crown Ivory at approximately 19–20px, centred, with a max-width of ~620px to maintain a comfortable reading line length. Line height ~1.65.

The section has generous vertical padding: approximately 100px top, 90px bottom on desktop, reducing to 64px top/bottom on mobile. No background image or texture — the flat Courtside Navy surface is dignified and intentional. A thin Championship Gold ornamental rule (full content-width, ~1px) sits at the very bottom of the section as a transition device into the next panel.

Contact Block section providing essential contact information alongside a vintage illustrated estate map. The section background is Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8). Content is contained within the standard max-width column (~1100px centred). Vertical padding approximately 88px top and bottom on desktop.

At the top of the section, the eyebrow 'Reach Us' appears in Montserrat uppercase, wide letter-spacing, Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F), ~12px. Below it, the H2 headline 'The Club Office' is set in Playfair Display, Courtside Navy, approximately 38–42px, sentence case, followed by a Championship Gold ornamental rule (~80px wide, centred, with a small crest diamond).

The section body below the headline — 'Our club office is staffed Monday through Saturday. For urgent match-day enquiries, please call the clubhouse directly. We aim to respond to all written enquiries within one working day.' — is set in Source Serif 4, Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A), ~17px, line-height 1.7, max-width ~560px, left-aligned within the left column.

The layout is a two-column grid on desktop: left column (~55% width) contains the contact details list; right column (~45% width) contains the illustrated estate map asset.

Left column — Contact Details List: Each of the five contact items (Address, Telephone, Email — General Enquiries, Email — Coaching & Memberships, Office Hours) is presented as a compact card row. Each row has a subtle Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) background, Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, 16px border-radius, and 20px internal padding. A small icon placeholder (location, phone, mail, mail, clock) sits to the left in Championship Gold, rendered at ~20px. The item title (e.g., 'Address', 'Telephone') is set in Montserrat small caps, Courtside Navy, ~11–12px, wide letter-spacing, as a label above the description. The description text is set in Source Serif 4, Ink Smoke, ~16px. Cards are stacked vertically with ~12px gap between them. On hover, the card surface shifts to a slightly deeper Antique Linen and the left border becomes a 3px Burgundy Crest accent.

Right column — Illustrated Estate Map Asset: The vintage illustrated site map of the Courtside & Crown grounds (showing eight courts, clubhouse, car park, and entrance gate in a heritage estate map style) is placed flush to the right of the two-column layout. It fills the full height of the left column content. The map is framed with a Championship Gold double-rule border (~2px outer, ~1px inner, ~4px gap) and a subtle Antique Linen mat behind it, giving it the feel of a framed estate document. A small caption below the map in Montserrat uppercase, Ink Smoke, ~10px, wide letter-spacing reads 'HARROWFIELD ESTATE · ASHBOURNE, DERBYSHIRE'.

On tablet, the two columns compress to equal widths. On mobile, the layout stacks vertically: contact detail cards first, then the illustrated map below at full width.

Feature Grid section routing visitors to the correct contact point for their enquiry type. Section background is Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) — the alternating panel fill — giving this section a warm, differentiated surface that signals a new content zone. Full-bleed panel, content constrained to ~1100px centred. Vertical padding ~88px top and bottom on desktop.

At the top centre of the section, the eyebrow 'What Can We Help With?' is set in Montserrat uppercase, wide letter-spacing, Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F), ~12px. Below it, the H2 headline 'Find the Right Door' is set in Playfair Display, Courtside Navy, ~38–42px, sentence case, centred. A Championship Gold ornamental divider rule (~80px, centred, small diamond) follows immediately below the headline. Section-level body copy is absent for this section.

Below the headline and divider, a four-card grid is laid out in a 2×2 arrangement on desktop (two cards per row), a 2×2 grid on tablet, and a single-column stack on mobile. Each card has a Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) surface, a 1px Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, ~16px border-radius, and ~32px internal padding. A subtle box-shadow (0 2px 8px rgba(27,42,74,0.07)) gives cards gentle lift off the Antique Linen background.

Each card contains: (1) A small circular heritage badge icon placeholder at the top-left of the card — rendered in Championship Gold outline style (~40px diameter), representing the enquiry category (key for Membership, racket for Coaching, building for Venue Hire, quill pen for Press). (2) The card title (e.g., 'Membership Enquiries') set in Playfair Display, Courtside Navy, ~20–22px, sentence case, sitting ~12px below the icon. (3) The description text set in Source Serif 4, Ink Smoke, ~16px, line-height 1.65, ~4px below the title. (4) A contact email address displayed at the bottom of the card as a styled link in Montserrat uppercase, Burgundy Crest, ~11px, wide letter-spacing, with a Championship Gold underline on hover.

Card hover state: surface shifts to a slightly warmer Antique Linen, the border upgrades to a 2px Championship Gold line, and the title colour shifts from Courtside Navy to Burgundy Crest. Transition is smooth at 200ms ease. Cards in the grid are separated by a ~24px gap both horizontally and vertically.

FAQ section answering the five most common prospective-member questions. Section background is Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8), returning to the primary page surface. Content constrained to ~760px centred max-width to focus readability. Vertical padding ~88px top and bottom on desktop.

At the top centre, the eyebrow 'Common Questions' is set in Montserrat uppercase, wide letter-spacing, Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F), ~12px. Below it, the H2 headline 'Before You Write, We May Already Have Your Answer' is set in Playfair Display, Courtside Navy, ~36–40px, sentence case, centred, max-width ~600px. A Championship Gold ornamental rule (~80px, centred, small diamond) follows below the headline.

The five FAQ items are presented as an accordion-style list, stacked vertically with ~8px gap between items. Each accordion item is a card-like row with a Crown Ivory surface, a 1px Slate Mist (#D6D9E0) border, and ~20px internal padding (left and right ~24px). The question (title) is set in Playfair Display, Courtside Navy, ~18px, with a small '+' expand icon in Championship Gold (~16px) aligned to the far right of the row. In the expanded/open state, the '+' becomes a '–', the border-left upgrades to a 3px Burgundy Crest accent, the background shifts to Antique Linen, and the answer text is revealed below the question with a smooth 200ms height transition.

Answer text is set in Source Serif 4, Ink Smoke (#4A4E5A), ~16px, line-height 1.7, with ~12px top padding separating it from the question text within the expanded card.

The asset idea for this section — a set of small circular heritage badge icons (key, racket, building, quill) in a classic wax-seal style — is positioned as a decorative horizontal row of four icons centred between the ornamental rule and the first FAQ item. Each icon is rendered at ~36px diameter in Championship Gold outline style, spaced ~32px apart, serving as a visual bridge between the headline zone and the FAQ list. They are purely decorative and non-interactive in this placement. On mobile, this icon row is hidden to reduce visual noise and the accordion items span full width.

CTA (Call to Action) closing section — the final element above the footer. This section is a full-bleed panel with a Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) background, mirroring the page header section to create a satisfying visual bookend that frames the entire contact page with authority and warmth.

The panel is symmetrically composed and centred. At the top, the eyebrow 'The First Step Is the Easiest' is set in Montserrat uppercase, wide letter-spacing (~0.15em), Championship Gold (#B8962E), ~12px. Below the eyebrow, a thin Championship Gold ornamental rule (~60px, centred, small diamond) separates it from the headline.

The H2 headline 'Your Court Is Waiting' is set in Playfair Display, Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8), ~48–52px on desktop, sentence case, tight letter-spacing, centred. Below the headline, the subheadline 'There has never been a better time to join Courtside & Crown. Get in touch today and we will take care of the rest.' is set in Source Serif 4, italic, Crown Ivory at 80% opacity (~rgba(245,240,232,0.8)), ~19px, centred, max-width ~560px, line-height 1.65.

Below the subheadline, two CTA buttons are displayed side-by-side in a horizontal row, centred, with ~16px gap between them. On mobile they stack vertically at full width.

Primary CTA 'Send Us a Message': Filled button with Burgundy Crest (#7D1D3F) background, Crown Ivory text in Montserrat uppercase, ~13px, wide letter-spacing, ~18px vertical padding, ~36px horizontal padding, ~4px border-radius.
